I collected 48 used Uber Eats paper bags, doubled them up into 24 planters, and grew potatoes, tomatoes, carrots, broccoli, and more. But could flimsy takeaway bags really survive months of weather, watering and growing, or would the whole experiment fall apart? Let’s see if this crazy paper bag free vegetable garden actually worked!
